airports.notes: Natural Earth airport points with trimmed properties.

highways.notes: ArcGIS Interstate Highway System lines with lightweight coordinate decimation.

military_bases.notes: Global military installations are built from GeoNames point records only. Allowed feature codes are filtered to AIRB, BRKS, STNC, NVB, and MILB; MILB records are branch-classified from centralized name rules when possible. Nearby duplicate names within the same country/branch are collapsed conservatively.

research_test_sites.notes: Research / Test Sites runtime now combines the original infrastructure package with the conservative Northern Europe defense-relevant research facility GeoJSON plus the Boeing Seattle Plant 2 contractor anchor. The shipped client remains point-based; contextual circle/square/rectangle markers are rendered symbolically from marker fields, not exact boundaries. QC/reference CSV/JSON/notes remain outside the runtime bundle.
